commitment: Flashblock preconfirmation (~200ms); full L2 block ~2s; hard Ethereum L1 finality ~15 min later
method: N real USDC ERC-20 self-payments pre-signed with consecutive EVM nonces and fired at once. Base's mempool queues future-nonce txs and the sequencer packs many consecutive ones per block, so one wallet CAN burst (unlike Stellar). Timed submit -> receipt (Flashblock preconfirmation).
